general.notes: Forward error correction (FEC) is required to be implemented by the host. LPO module does not have a CDR. Receiver sensitivity (OMA) -5.1 dBm at TECQ≤1.4 dB per lane; alternate row gives -6.5+TECQ dBm for 1.4 dB<TECQ≤3.4 dB per lane. Sensitivity measured with PRBS31Q test pattern, BER@2.4*10^-4. Wavelength assignment 1304.5–1317.5 nm suitable for all channels. Optical receiver damage threshold 5.0 dBm per lane. Power dissipation stated as <8.5 W (Typical 7.5 W). Link power budget typ. 7.8 dB for maximum TDECQ; allocation for penalties (for maximum TDECQ) 3.8 dB.
